scope: Earned W1-W5 weapon screening, not human win rates or full-run rankings

arms.method: Rule-based, delayed common-viewport observations; diagnostic, not human winrates. Independent movement and build policies, actual movement/dash and earned progression. Probes ending by W5 retain the historical early boss-kill stop. Longer runs follow complete timed boss waves, loot, offered relics and shops through W20. One free starter; all subsequent gear and ranks are earned. No future spawns or hidden attack planning.
